Subject: Summit Bottle is back — limited stock
Preview: 750 ml, 24-hour cold, 12-hour hot. Grab one before they're gone.
Body: Your next trip deserves water that stays cold.

The Northbay Summit Insulated Bottle (NB-BTL-03) is back in stock — and quantities are limited, so this won't last long.

Here's what it does:

• 750 ml capacity — enough for a solid half-day push without a refill stop.
• Double-wall stainless steel construction keeps drinks cold for 24 hours and hot for 12 hours.
• Built for the trail, not for your desk — though it works fine there too.

This bottle isn't built for ultralight gram-counting missions where every ounce matters. It's built for the person who wants their water cold at the top of the climb and their coffee hot at the morning trailhead.

Stock is limited. When it's gone, it's gone.
